title: I kept breaking my own risk rules in practice, so I made the simulator grade me on them
author: dmiseev
selftext:
been posting here and in a few trading subs about my replay numbers, the pattern was always the same. the rules were fine, i just didnt follow them. no stop "just this once", 3 trades turns into 11

so i built it into the sim. before a session you tick the rules you're trading by (always use a stop, max N trades, max leverage etc). you trade the replay bar by bar, future hidden, and at the end you get a report card. each rule checked, every broken one costs points

video is me breaking the stop rule on purpose, the score drops and it tells you exactly which rule failed

its called Backcandle, i made it. free tier is 10 sessions a day, no card: [https://backcandle.com/?utm\_source=reddit&utm\_medium=social&utm\_campaign=ai\_trading\_discipline](https://backcandle.com/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ai_trading_discipline)

curious what rules you'd actually want tracked. thinking about adding max daily loss and "no revenge trade within X min after a loss"
